description: Copy this file to AGENTS.appetite.json or org/<customer>/appetite.json and edit it. It is an additional bar the deploying organization sets for `npm run layers:diff -- --fail-on-appetite`. It does not waive a core rule: secrets.* and refusal.* relaxations still fail `npm run audit`, and there is no waiver mechanism. Fetch-on-Demand and named refusal criteria stay in force. Consequence classes are descriptive labels. Attestations log who noted a preference-rule difference; they do not change the reporter's exit code and they do not waive a core rule.

attestations.reason: Interactive sessions use the organization gateway. Reference workflows keep the upstream pin.
